title: Training-Free Interventions for Hallucination in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.29909v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A frozen language model can give a wrong answer because a fact is unavailable, a reliable passage is ignored, or an unsupported claim survives generation. We review 116 works on inference-time hallucination intervention and its foundations. We trace the development from retrieval and controllable generation to methods that act on input evidence, token scores, internal representations, completed claims, or the decision to answer. For each family we compare its source of evidence, model access, preparation cost, and the task on which a correction can be established. For activation steering, we distinguish estimating a subspace from applying a state-dependent edit and separate interventions on the prompt from those on the generated prefix. Published comparisons show why faithfulness to a source, factual correctness, informativeness, and answer coverage must be measured separately. Applications in time-sensitive question answering, document

translated_title: 大语言模型幻觉的免训练干预方法
translated_abstract: 一个冻结的语言模型给出错误答案的原因可能是：某个事实不可用、可靠的文本段落被忽略，或者缺乏依据的断言在生成过程中幸存下来。我们回顾了116篇关于推理阶段幻觉干预及其理论基础的研究。我们梳理了这些方法从检索和可控生成，发展到作用于输入证据、token分数、内部表示、已生成的断言或是否回答的决策的过程。对于每个方法族，我们比较了其证据来源、所需的模型访问权限、准备成本以及可以在哪类任务上验证纠正效果。对于激活引导方法，我们区分了估计子空间与应用依赖状态的编辑，并区分了针对提示词的干预与针对已生成前缀的干预。已发表的对比结果表明，对来源的忠实性、事实正确性、信息量和答案覆盖度必须分别进行测量。该方法在时间敏感的问答、文档……等场景中的应用（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文系统综述了116篇关于大语言模型推理阶段免训练幻觉干预的研究，按证据来源、模型访问需求、准备成本和适用任务对各方法族进行分类比较，并强调忠实性、事实正确性、信息量与答案覆盖度需分别评测。
en_tdlr: This paper surveys 116 works on training-free, inference-time interventions for LLM hallucination, categorizing methods by evidence source, model access, preparation cost, and applicable task, and showing that faithfulness, factual correctness, informativeness, and answer coverage must be evaluated separately.
